items.text: MOBA Warmup Gym's build was 71% textures. It wasn't compression -- it was resolution: we dropped the Synty atlases to 512 and VRAM went from 58 to 31.6 MB, with no visible difference (checked with a pixel diff, not eyeballing it). Combined with the audio pass, the zip went from 47.6 to 35.9 MB.
